name: Umkhuhlane (influenza)
tagline: Ukuphumula nini. Umshayele nini udokotela wakho.

what_is_it.heading: Flu ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Umkhuhlane ukutheleleka ngegciwane emakhaleni, emphinjeni, namaphaphu. Kunolaka kakhulu kunomkhuhlane ovamile - imfiva, ubuhlungu bomzimba, nokukhathala kufika emahoreni ambalwa.
paragraphs: Abantu abaningi abaphile kahle bayalulama phakathi nesonto kuya ezinsukwini eziyishumi. Ingozi ilele ezinkingeni - inyumoniya, ukuwohloka kwesifuba somoya noma isifo senhliziyo, ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kubantu asebekhulile kanye nezingane ezincane. Balinganiselwa ku-11,000 abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abashona ngenxa yezinkinga ezihlobene nomkhuhlane minyaka yonke.

Umkhuhlane awuwona nje umkhuhlane omubi. Amakhaza angena kancane. Umkhuhlane uhlasela emahoreni ambalwa - ukushisa okuphezulu, ukukhwehlela okomile, ubuhlungu bemisipha, ikhanda elibuhlungu, kanye nohlobo lokukhathala okukubeka embhedeni.

items.headline: Okwesizini
items.body: Isikhathi somkhuhlane waseNingizimu Afrika siqala ngoMeyi kuya kuSepthemba. Gonywa ngoMashi noma ngo-Ephreli.

items.headline: Usabulala
items.body: Cishe abantu abayi-11,000 baseNingizimu Afrika bafa ngonyaka - ikakhulukazi ngenxa yezinkinga ezifana nenyumoniya, ikakhulukazi kwasebekhulile kanye nabagula kakhulu.

items.headline: Umuthi wokugoma wamahhala
items.body: Amaqembu asengozini enkulu athola imigomo yamahhala yomkhuhlane emitholampilo - abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65, abesifazane abakhulelwe, ukugula okungapheli, abasebenzi bezempilo.

items.headline: Phumula, hhayi ama-antibiotic
items.body: Abantu abadala abanempilo ngokuvamile badinga ukuphumula, uketshezi, nesikhathi—hhayi ama-antibiotics. Ama-antibiotics awasebenzi ngokumelene namagciwane.

pull_quote.text: Umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane awukwazi ukukunika umkhuhlane - leyo ngenye yezinganekwane eziphikelelayo neziyingozi. Umuthi wokugoma awunalo igciwane eliphilayo.

signs.heading: Umkhuhlane ngokumelene nokubanda - ukusho kanjani
signs.lede: Umkhuhlane kanye nemikhuhlane yizifo ezehlukene. Ukwazi ukuthi yikuphi onakho kushintsha lokho okwenzayo ngokulandelayo.

items.title: Umkhuhlane uhlasela ngokushesha futhi ngamandla
items.description: Ukushisa okuphezulu (ngaphezu kuka-38°C) kwenzeka emahoreni ambalwa, ubuhlungu obukhulu bomzimba, ukukhwehlela okomile, ukukhathala. Uzizwa unqotshiwe.

items.title: Amakhaza akheka kancane
items.description: Ikhala eligijimayo, umphimbo obuhlungu, ukukhathala okuncane. Uzizwa ulukhuni kodwa usebenza. Akukho umkhuhlane omkhulu, akukho buhlungu bomzimba.

items.title: Izimpawu eziyisixwayiso
items.description: Ukuphefumula kanzima, ubuhlungu besifuba, izindebe eziluhlaza, ukuhlanza okukhulu, ukudideka, izimpawu eziba ngcono bese ziba zimbi kungazelelwe — bonana nomtholampilo.

spreads.heading: Indlela umkhuhlane osakazeka ngayo
yes: Ukukhwehlela kanye nokuthimula okuvela kubantu abanaleli gciwane - amaconsi ahamba cishe imitha
Izindawo ezithinta umuntu onegciwane akhwehlele kuzo, bese ethinta ubuso bakho
Ukuthintana eduze ezindaweni ezingenawo umoya ohlanzekile - amakilasi, amatekisi, amahhovisi
Kusuka kumuntu onegciwane kusukela ngosuku ngaphambi kokuba azizwe egula
no: Ukubanda noma ukuba manzi - umkhuhlane awubangeli umkhuhlane, igciwane liyawenza
Umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane - awunalo igciwane eliphilayo

prevention.heading: Ungazivikela kanjani wena nomndeni wakho
prevention.lede: Umgomo womkhuhlane waminyaka yonke uyinto eyodwa ephumelela kakhulu. Ngisho noma usathola umkhuhlane ngemva kokugoma, ngokuvamile uthambile kakhulu.

items.title: Umgomo wonyaka womkhuhlane
items.description: Gonywa minyaka yonke ngaphambi kwenkathi yomkhuhlane. Kumahhala emitholampilo emaqenjini asengozini enkulu, cishe u-R100 emakhemisi amaningi awo wonke umuntu.

items.title: Geza izandla njalo
items.description: Insipho namanzi imizuzwana engu-20, noma isibulali magciwane. Ikakhulukazi ngemva kwezithuthi zomphakathi, ukuyothenga, noma ukulayishwa esikoleni.

items.title: Ukungenisa umoya
items.description: Vula amafasitela ezindlini, emakilasini, nasemahhovisi. Umkhuhlane usakazeka kancane kakhulu ezindaweni ezinomoya omuhle.

items.title: Hlala ekhaya uma ugula
items.description: Uma unomkhuhlane, hlala ekhaya amahora angu-24 ngemva kokugqashuka komkhuhlane. Uyatheleleka kakhulu ezinsukwini zokuqala ezingu-3-4.

items.fact: Umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane awunalo igciwane eliphilayo. Abanye abantu bazizwa bekhathele noma banomkhuhlane omncane ngemva kokudutshulwa - lokho amasosha omzimba asabelayo, hhayi umkhuhlane.

items.myth: Uma ngiwumqemane, angiwudingi umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane.
items.fact: Abantu abanempilo ngokuvamile bayasinda emkhuhlaneni - kodwa uwusakaza kubantu abasengozini enkulu. Ukugoma kukuvikela wena nezingane zakho, abazali, nozakwenu.
Ama-antibiotic asebenza kuphela ngokumelene namagciwane. Umkhuhlane uyigciwane. Ukuthatha ama-antibiotics kungenasidingo kuzalela amagciwane amelana ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

items.myth: Uma nginezimpawu, isikhathi sesihambile sokuthola umgomo.
items.fact: Uma usuvele unomkhuhlane, umuthi wokugoma ngeke welapha leso siqephu - kodwa awukephuzi kakhulu isizini iyonke. Kuvame ukuba nokuchayeka okwengeziwe kamuva.

items.title: Ukuphumula, uketshezi, i-paracetamol
items.description: Lala ngokusemandleni akho. Phuza amanzi, ijusi, isobho. I-Paracetamol noma ibuprofen yemfiva nama-aches.

items.title: Ungaceli ama-antibiotics
items.description: Umkhuhlane unegciwane. Ama-antibiotics awawenzi lutho amagciwane. Zisiza kuphela uma kuvela inkinga yebhaktheriya njengenyumoniya.

items.title: Uma usengozini enkulu - bonana nomtholampilo kusenesikhathi
items.description: Ukhulelwe, uneminyaka engaphezu kuka-65, ukugula okungapheli (isifuba somoya, isifo senhliziyo, isifo sikashukela, i-HIV)? Bona umtholampilo emahoreni angama-48 - ama-antiviral asebenza kangcono kusenesikhathi.

items.title: Qaphela izimpawu eziyisixwayiso
items.description: Ukuphefumula kanzima, ubuhlungu besifuba, ukudideka, ukuhlanza okukhulu, ukuwohloka okungazelelwe - thola usizo lwezempilo.

items.title: Vikela abanye
items.description: Hlala ekhaya kuze kuphele umkhuhlane amahora angama-24. Mboza ukukhwehlela ngendololwane. Ungavakasheli izihlobo esezikhulile lapho ugula.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Umkhuhlane omningi ungalawuleka ekhaya. Imitholampilo namakhemisi asiza ngezimpawu ezinzima kanye namaqembu asengozini enkulu.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni inikeza imigomo yamahhala yomkhuhlane emaqenjini asengozini enkulu
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo
